data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## test-exempt
Justification: (1) no conditional logic — pure markdown cross-reference addition, (2) any test would be a change-detector test only, (3) documentation artifact with no executable behavior.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD1 (partial): both contracts referenced from review-fix-dispatch.md (the reference requirement)

## What
Modify `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md` to add cross-references to both new contract documents.

## Where to Add References
In the "Defend findings" section (around line 82-91 where REVIEW-DEFENSE inline comment guidance exists), add a note referencing the new contracts. Add one or two lines such as:

> **Schema contracts**: For stateful re-review (cycle N+1), findings use the relation taxonomy defined in `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md`. Defense records follow the DefenseStore shape defined in `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md`.

This addition is additive — do NOT remove the existing inline REVIEW-DEFENSE guidance (the full removal is handled by the SC6 migration story 2aa7-2595).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] review-fix-dispatch.md references review-findings-schema.md
  Verify: grep -q "review-findings-schema.md" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md
- [ ] review-fix-dispatch.md references review-defenses.md
  Verify: grep -q "review-defenses.md" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add review contract references to review-fix-dispatch.md
